Abstract:Federated Learning (FL) allows for secure analysis of distributed data without data sharing. We and others have successfully applied FL to neuroimaging tasks, such as Alzheimer's disease classification from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). FL trains a deep learning model locally at each site, encrypts the local model parameters and sends them to a federation controller that aggregates the local models under homomorphic encryption, the resulting community model is sent back to the sites for further training, and the process repeats for a number of rounds. FL often achieves learning performance (e.g., accuracy) close to centralized training, but no data leaves the sites and model parameters are protected through encryption and other measures.In this paper, we show that federations composed of sites with heterogeneous amounts of data (1 large site plus small sites) perform better than homogeneous (same data per site) federations, particularly in low data regimes, while reaching performance close to centralized training. 200. 【2610.38162】Neighbourhood shortcuts in building damage assessment from very-high-resolution satellite imagery: diagnosis and a building-evidence plug-in

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38162

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Building damage assessment (BDA) from very-high-resolution imagery supports disaster response, and deep models now achieve high overall accuracy on public benchmarks. Because damage is spatially clustered, most buildings share the damage level of their neighbours, so overall scores are dominated by such buildings, whereas damaged buildings among intact ones are rare and easily overlooked. A high overall score therefore cannot tell whether a model judges the building itself or relies on its neighbourhood as a shortcut, and this study tests which of the two current models do. We stratify buildings by their agreement with their neighbours, move buildings into new neighbourhoods with their pixels unchanged, and diagnose nine models covering the main paradigms of BDA. All models miss a third to half of the isolated damaged buildings, and in non-flood events they call 73--87% of intact buildings damaged once these are moved into a damaged neighbourhood. We propose a building-evidence plug-in that adds two experts to an existing model without retraining it. One expert sees only the building, and the other sees its surroundings but is trained with seamlessly swapped neighbourhoods so that it learns not to trust them. With each of the nine models, the plug-in maintains or improves overall accuracy, reduces errors on buildings that disagree with their neighbours by 8--18%, and cuts by 40--69% the intact buildings that a damaged neighbourhood turns into damaged ones. It also raises the detection of synthetic isolated damage from 1--6% to 13--39% and carries over to optical--SAR data and to an unseen earthquake. High overall scores thus conceal a systematic reliance on the neighbourhood, which building-level evidence reduces at low cost.

201. 【2610.38158】REEL: Same Frames, Different Answers and Different Costs

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38158

作者：Xin Liang,Jiangpeng He

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Prefix State, longer recordings, understanding keeps moving, Video understanding, Prefix

备注： Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027, Datasets and Evaluation Track

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Video understanding keeps moving toward longer recordings, and the longer a recording is, the more questions can be asked about it. But processing it again for every question does not scale, so many systems watch the video once, build a memory, and answer later questions from it. Yet what to remember is decided before anyone knows what will be asked, and whatever is left out cannot be recovered later.Moreover, whether the savings pay off is judged by token counts, which fall when the input gets shorter but not when the model reuses what it has already computed. We present REEL, an evaluation framework that compares three saved representations built from exactly the same observed frames, so that a change in answers can come only from what the system remembered. Text writes a short record of what happened, Visual keeps the encoder outputs, and Prefix State also keeps the language-model prefix. Each is compared with full reprocessing (Frames) by paired correctness changes, cumulative GPU time, and storage size. Across six vision-language models and two benchmarks, Text and Frames differ in correctness on 20\% to 29\% of questions, even when their mean accuracy is almost the same. By contrast, Visual and Prefix State stay much closer to Frames. With unlimited storage, Prefix State is the cheapest in total GPU time among memories that keep almost all of the answers Frames gets right, for every model on both benchmarks. The trade-off is storage: Prefix State keeps up to about 21 GiB per video, whereas Text needs only kilobytes. Reusing computation and discarding information both look like efficiency, but only the second removes evidence that later questions may need, and neither mean accuracy nor token count tells them apart. REEL makes that difference measurable for any system that answers many questions from one saved memory.

Abstract:Controllable human motion generation has largely focused on specifying what action should occur or where the body should move. We study a complementary question: can full-body motion be controlled by specifying only when each foot contacts the ground? We introduce StepControl, an autoregressive diffusion model conditioned on a future binary left/right foot-contact schedule, without requiring target root and body poses, or semantic prompts. StepControl represents contact as explicit temporal events and injects them through dedicated cross-attention with classifier-free guidance. Abstract:LOL-v1 and LOLv2-Real are the standard benchmarks for supervised low-light image enhancement, and several leading methods ship hand-set test-time adjustments with their evaluation scripts. We audit both benchmarks with 18 public checkpoints of eight methods under one metric implementation that reproduces every published number to within 0.09 dB, and find that their test labels differ from their training labels. (i) The 15 LOL-v1 test labels are rendered differently: the same captures appear in LOLv2 with labels of identical luminance but 1.48x lower saturation, and LOL-v1's own training labels match the LOLv2 rendering; we confirm this on the official release. (ii) The LOLv2-Real test set is the contiguous block of images 690-789, whose labels are 14% darker than the training labels (Cliff's delta = -0.45, p 1e-12) with no comparable shift in the input statistics we examined; methods trained without any labels score up to 5.5 dB higher on test than on train. (iii) All 15 LOL-v1 test inputs reappear in LOLv2-Real, 12 in its training set. The released test-time settings are consistent with compensating for these shifts. Separating what can be calibrated on training data from what only test-set tuning finds, the test-only residual has median 0.00 dB on LOLv2-Syn, which has no shift, but 0.37 dB on LOL-v1 and 0.92 dB on LOLv2-Real (up to 3.9 dB). Under the shift, test-set checkpoint selection inflates a from-scratch model by 0.9-2.0 dB, and removing the released settings changes which method ranks first. We give concrete reporting recommendations.

Abstract:Deciding which member of an animal group produced a vocalization and where that vocalization was produced are central to studying social communication but are rarely evaluated with physically verified ground truth. Existing resources either localize sounds without identifying the caller, or recognize individuals from isolated vocalizations without reliance on the 3D candidate geometry. We close this gap with V33DA, a dataset-centered multimodal benchmark for spatial vocal attribution in social zebra finches: it comprises 33,625 verified events coupling 5-channel audio with three camera views, calibrated 3D pose for every visible candidate, and per-bird radio telemetry across 10 individuals and three experiments. Caller identity is verified from an on-body accelerometer-derived vibration signal; this channel is withheld from benchmark models and used only by an on-body reference ceiling. Given a detected vocalization and the visible candidate birds, the task is to select the caller. We evaluate it under three regimes: session-disjoint testing on familiar birds from held-out recording dates, held-out-experiment transfer to a new cohort, and leave-one-individual-out evaluation on a bird whose vocalizations are held out from training. The on-body reference stays near-perfect across regimes, confirming the internal consistency of the accelerometer-verified labels. We release V33DA with fixed protocols and code for the evaluated methods, and V33DA++, an unevaluated companion set of verified overlapping-call events and +/-2 s context windows.

Abstract:We introduce The Prestige, a video understanding benchmark that probes cognitive visual reasoning through professional magic performances, where deliberate misdirection challenges models to track events and explain unexpected outcomes. The benchmark comprises open-ended questions ranging from temporal and causal understanding to robustness against adversarial questions. Abstract:Traditional computed tomography (CT) can capture paired 3D face and skull geometry, but it remains costly, fixed in location, and exposes patients to radiation. 210. 【2610.38042】Can Event Detectors Leave the Broadcast Camera? Evidence from Tennis

Abstract:Ball bounces and racket hits are the events from which tennis statistics are derived, and on monocular video the two are easy to confuse. We release a benchmark of 345 bounce and hit annotations at frame level on eight clips that mix broadcast, fixed elevated, phone and court-level viewpoints, with a frozen development and test split, a confusion-aware matcher, clip-level bootstrap intervals and a blind second annotation of three clips. On it we score supervised precise spotters with published broadcast weights, two zero-shot vision-language models, and RallyArb, an arbitration layer over a ball track and player poses that fits no parameter on event labels. The supervised spotters score near-perfectly on broadcast footage and almost nothing on phone and court-level footage, where the pooled bounce F1 of E2E-Spot is 0.130. RallyArb keeps a bounce F1 above 0.8 on the three phone and court-level clips, two of which were used to tune it, and finds 8 of 11 bounces on the held-out one, but it places hits too far from the contact frame to match human timing. 211. 【2610.38013】Where Can We Fool the Model's Mind? Response-Guided Semantic Probing and Adaptive Routing for Transferable Attacks on Black-Box MLLMs

作者：Ahmed Abdelnaby,Mohamed Elmahallawy

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) ground language in visual evidence, yet their semantic reasoning can be exploited through transferable black-box adversarial attacks. Existing attacks typically allocate perturbations using surrogate-model saliency, which may not reflect how an unseen MLLM semantically interprets or relies on different image regions. We introduce VISTA (Vulnerability-Informed Semantic Transfer Attacks), a black-box framework that identifies semantically vulnerable visual regions from an MLLM's responses without access to gradients, logits, parameters, or internal representations. VISTA supports two attack settings: (i) VISTA-Proxy, a pure-transfer setting that probes an open-source MLLM and transfers the resulting adversarial examples to unseen commercial MLLMs without querying them; and (ii) VISTA-Victim, a query-assisted setting that probes the target MLLM to capture model-specific semantic vulnerabilities. VISTA builds an Uncertainty-Based Multimodal Behavior (UBMB) map from response drift, conflict, misleading, and semantic shifts, then uses entropy-adaptive Sinkhorn routing and a surrogate ensemble to focus perturbations on vulnerable regions. Across GPT-5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, VISTA achieves up to 97 % attack success rate (ASR) while maintaining a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) above 30 dB. Notably, VISTA-Proxy achieves up to 93 % ASR without querying the final victim, demonstrating that response-derived semantic vulnerability can enable effective transfer across heterogeneous MLLMs.

Abstract:Neural representation has emerged as a powerful tool to mitigate the demand for increasingly higher-resolution images. However, a fundamental trade-off remains between structured (e.g., feature grids, which offer spatial consistency) and unstructured (e.g., 2D Gaussians, which adaptively capture local variances) representations. This choice significantly affects how well an algorithm represents an image. Abstract:We address the task of long-video, camera-controlled generation from a single image. The dominant autoregressive paradigm suffers from two key limitations: (1) error accumulation over time, as distant frames are conditioned on previously generated outputs rather than ground truth, leading to drift; and (2) ambiguity in how to incorporate camera control. Standard solutions to both--such as self-forcing and conditioning on explicit 6-DOF poses--either incur significant computational overhead or produce drifting scene geometries over time. We propose a simple and lightweight framework that combines autoregressive generation (WanAR) with hierarchical long-context denoising (FixAR). To enforce scene geometry remains consistent with input cameras, we draw from feed-forward novel-view synthesis and reformulate video generation as a warping-and-inpainting problem. To mitigate drift, we introduce a hierarchical denoising strategy in which different stages condition on different temporal histories. Specifically, we first generate frames conditioned on the immediate past, and then refine them using a second denoiser conditioned on a temporally subsampled long-range history to enforce global consistency. This fine-to-coarse scheme enables each generated frame to effectively condition on the full temporal context without incurring a prohibitive cost. Experiments on RealEstate10k and DL3DV demonstrate that WanAR+FixAR outperforms prior methods for camera-controlled long-video generation, producing results that are both temporally stable and consistent with input camera trajectories.

Abstract:Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. Abstract:A widely held assumption in knowledge distillation is that teacher and student representations must occupy a compatible or explicitly aligned feature space. We propose RPKD (Random Prototype Knowledge Distillation), which discards this assumption by comparing both networks against a shared bank of randomly initialized, frozen prototype vectors. Alignment is therefore carried out in an external reference space rather than in the teacher's native feature coordinates: the teacher side is projected by fixed random maps that carry no trainable parameters, and only the student adapts. Two branches handle the transfer: a logit branch aligning global prototype similarity distributions and a feature branch matching spatially-resolved prototype activation maps. Both operate within the same fixed prototype space, which can be interpreted as a random feature embedding that approximately preserves inter-sample similarity structure, so the prototype bank and the distillation objective stay unchanged across teacher-student pairs while only the input projections are instantiated per architecture. In low-category settings, decoupling the prototype vocabulary from the task label space yields richer supervision than the label space alone, an advantage absent from logit-based methods, whose supervisory signal collapses as class count shrinks. This advantage is especially relevant in real-world scenarios where the label space is typically constrained. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RPKD, achieving a maximum gain of +7.98% over OFA on CIFAR-100, +12.44% on ImageNet-100, and +1.28% on ImageNet-1K. 218. 【2610.37882】FYC: FPR-Disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration for Fair Deepfake Detection

Abstract:Deepfake detectors routinely achieve high aggregate accuracy while exhibiting substantial demographic disparities in their errors: false-positive rates differ by double digits across gender and skin tone. Most existing remedies require either full retraining with a fairness-aware objective or demographic-annotated training data, both impractical when only a pretrained checkpoint is available, while label-free post-hoc calibrators leave the detector's weights unchanged. We introduce FYC (FPR-disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration), a two-stage post-hoc method that perturbs a detector's weights under an FPR-disparity criterion, then calibrates a separate decision threshold for each demographic group - requiring no architectural changes and no full retraining. Evaluated against every detector benchmarked on AI-Face v2 across six intersectional gender x skin-tone groups, FYC outperforms the field on 18 of 21 reported fairness and utility metrics, including purpose-built fairness architectures, at a fraction of the training cost. We further identify why the choice of fairness criterion is critical: the original Demographic Parity objective used in prior weight-perturbation work is architecture-dependent and unpredictable, improving two of four evaluated architectures, leaving a third largely unchanged, and substantially degrading the fourth (PG-FDD), with no way to anticipate the outcome for a given checkpoint in advance. Conditioning the same objective on real images only - our FPR-disparity criterion - eliminates this unpredictability, improving fairness and accuracy jointly across all four architectures with no exceptions.

219. 【2610.37881】Intersectional Invariant Learning for Fair Deepfake Detection

Abstract:Deepfake detection models achieve high overall accuracy but exhibit large performance disparities across demographic groups, causing some groups to experience substantially higher false-positive rates than others. Existing fairness-aware methods address this by constraining model outputs to equalize group predictions, but do not tackle the underlying feature-level bias. As a result, models may still rely on demographic characteristics, such as skin texture, as indirect cues for detecting manipulated content. To address this problem, we propose Intersectional Invariant Learning (IIL), a framework that improves feature learning rather than only adjusting model outputs. IIL alternates between identifying the most challenging demographic partitions and learning features that remain consistent across those partitions. The framework also includes a false-positive-rate fairness objective and group-balanced sampling across six gender x skin-tone intersectional groups. We evaluate IIL on a large-scale fairness benchmark containing over one million images, 10 baseline detectors, and 21 fairness and utility metrics. Results show that IIL achieves Pareto-optimal performance, simultaneously attaining an AUC above 99%, a false-positive rate under 2.5%, and the lowest intersectional fairness disparity (FMEO) among all compared methods. IIL outperforms prior fairness-aware methods on the large majority of the 21 evaluation metrics, while reducing both false-positive rates and intersectional fairness disparities by several-fold compared with the strongest competing method.

220. 【2610.37874】PairCLIP-SWA: Similarity-Guided Balancing and Stochastic Weight Averaging for Generalized Deepfake Image Detection with OpenCLIP

Abstract:Deepfake detectors are almost always deployed as the single checkpoint that scored best on a validation split, yet the reliability of that choice is rarely measured. Its training log shows why averaging matters: over the averaged epochs the non-averaged checkpoint swings across 5.34 points of validation accuracy while its validation loss more than doubles, whereas the average is never worse and is up to 5.99 points better. On an OpenForensics-derived benchmark the same instability becomes a misranking: the checkpoint that validation accuracy selects (98.43%) scores 88.85% on a disjoint 10,905-image test partition, rejecting 21.1% of genuine photographs, while the terminal average, ranked last on validation, scores 94.76%. 221. 【2610.37867】What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine

作者：Saransh Kumar Gupta,Akshadha Sharma,Lipika Dey,Partha Pratim Das,Ramesh Jain

Abstract:Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-representation agreement. We also aggregate image representations to compare dish-level visual similarity across models and against recipe-derived similarity for the same dishes. Image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations, including similarities across culinary-family boundaries. At the dish level, aggregation reveals common visual structure despite local variation, but this structure corresponds less strongly with recipe-derived similarity. These findings show that recognition performance alone cannot characterize relational structure: food similarity depends on representation, modality, and abstraction level rather than being a fixed property of the food collection. Understanding these structures is therefore a prerequisite to combining multiple food information modalities into a coherent notion of similarity.

Abstract:Two-dimensional (2D) intraglottal particle image velocimetry (PIV) of ex vivo phonation experiments quantifies vocal fold medial surface dynamics and the intraglottal flow field. Abstract:Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Abstract:Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.

Abstract:Humans navigate their environment based on their vision system, anticipating how the ground will respond before committing to a step. Both metrics are compared against state-of-the-art alternatives in two independent evaluations that share no data or labels. On 1716 manually annotated contacts, both variants outperform every evaluated alternative at detecting instability and ranking its severity, improving pooled severity ranking by 28 % over the strongest baseline. On three outdoor test runs, our metric also trains the most accurate visual predictor, improving rank correlation by 58 % over the strongest alternative, and by a further 25 % when supplemented with onboard context. Abstract:Measurements of tree diameter at breast height (DBH) are fundamental to forest inventories, but manual surveys across entire stands or regions are impractical. UAV-borne laser scanning (ULS) enables scalable automated forest surveys, yet canopy occlusion makes accurate DBH estimation from ULS point clouds non-trivial. Limited stem-level point density of ULS data constrains approaches relying on detailed stem reconstruction, such as Quantitative Structure Models (QSMs) and circle fitting. Empirical machine learning methods based on predefined point cloud metrics are an alternative. New deep learning approaches offer an even more principled solution, allowing models to learn directly from point clouds. Sparse tensor networks have shown particular promise, transforming forestry tasks such as tree species classification. We investigate whether these strengths can be extended to estimate individual tree DBH from ULS data across four mixed-species temperate forest plots in Germany. We further advance existing sparse tensor networks by introducing TreeNext, a lightweight deep learning architecture for direct individual tree parameter estimation from voxelized LiDAR point clouds. We present a fully automated forest inventory pipeline from individual tree instance segmentation to DBH regression, and quantify the impact of segmentation errors by comparing performance on automatically segmented and ground truth instances. TreeNext achieves an $R^2$ of 0.8355 on automatically segmented trees and 0.9380 on ground truth segments, outperforming strong tabular baselines including Random Forest and XGBoost. Segmentation quality emerges as the dominant error source in the automated pipeline. TreeNext proves highly data-efficient, performing well even in small data scenarios. Our findings establish sparse tensor networks as a practical foundation for automated individual tree DBH estimation from ULS.

Abstract:Simulation-to-reality translation must bridge the appearance gap between synthetic and real domains while preserving structural and semantic consistency. Conditioning-based methods achieve spatial alignment but introduce computationally expensive control modules. Paired-data methods achieve realism but rely on complex synthesis pipelines, often altering scene geometry and semantics. Training-free editing methods avoid both constraints but lack a learned appearance prior, limiting their perceptual quality. Recently proposed phase-preserving diffusion presents a promising alternative, but Fourier-domain formulations are constrained by global spectral coupling. This coupling induces spatial artifacts such as ringing and boundary leakage, thereby degrading structural and semantic consistency. We introduce Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which addresses this through two components. First, we operate in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain, whose localized wavelet packets enable spatially adaptive phase injection without global spectral interference. Second, Low-Frequency Randomization (LFR) replaces the low-frequency packet, decoupling the model from the synthetic illumination prior and enabling in-distribution real-world appearance. Both components train on unpaired open-domain data, and introduce negligible inference overhead. The spatial locality further enables instance-level translation, where individual objects or regions are translated to photorealistic appearance independently while the surrounding scene remains untranslated. On vKITTI $\to$ KITTI image translation, $\psi$-PD outperforms prior methods in realism and semantic consistency while maintaining competitive structural alignment. For CARLA video translation, $\psi$-PD approaches the realism of paired-data methods while reducing VLM planner ADE and FDE by $5.4\%$ and $5.1\%$, respectively.

229. 【2607.03487】owards Diverse and Comprehensive Benchmarks for Mutual Information Estimation

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03487

作者：Alberto Foresti,Ivan Butakov,Alexander Tolmachev,Giulio Franzese,Alexey Frolov,Pietro Michiardi

类目：Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Information Theory (cs.IT)

关键词：Mutual information, data largely unexplored, realistic data largely, existing benchmarks typically, low-dimensional distributions

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Mutual information (MI) estimation is a central problem in machine learning and statistics; however, existing benchmarks typically evaluate estimators on simplified, low-dimensional distributions, leaving their performance on complex, realistic data largely unexplored. We address this gap with a comprehensive benchmarking framework grounded in a unified copula-theoretic perspective that subsumes existing benchmarks as special cases. Within this framework, we propose two complementary families of tests: a copula-first family that systematically varies ground-truth MI, dimensionality, and marginal complexity using synthetic and flow-based transformations; and a marginals-first family that couples real-world image data with controlled dependency structures, extending the classic same-class-pairing paradigm. We use this suite to extensively evaluate three classes of estimators: non-parametric, discriminative, and generative. Contrary to prevailing assumptions, our results indicate that there is no universal winner: each category can systematically outperform all other estimators under specific setups. By analyzing these cases, we identify fundamental estimation barriers and propose new tests that more effectively stress these specific limitations. We share the open source code at this https URL.

230. 【2606.15768】LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15768

作者：Jialei Chen,Kai Wang,Kang Chen,Shuaihang Chen,Feng Gao,Wenhao Tang,Zhiyuan Li,Weilin Liu,Zhuyu Yao,Boxun Li,Yuanbo Xu,Chao Yu

类目：Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：leverage large-scale vision-language, large-scale vision-language pretraining, lack explicit foresight, leverage large-scale, large-scale vision-language

备注： Accepted at CoRL 2026. Project website: [this https URL](https://rlinf.github.io/LaWAM/)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.

231. 【2610.39972】Blind Video Denoising for Vocal Tract rtMRI using a Self-Supervised Ensemble

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39972

作者：Julian Andres Hernandez-Potes,Tomás Arias-Vergara,Daiqi Liu,Andreas Maier,Paula Andrea Perez-Toro

类目：Image and Video Processing (eess.IV); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Real-time magnetic resonance, articulation directly observable, magnetic resonance imaging, makes speech articulation, speech articulation directly

备注： 7 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Real-time magnetic resonance imaging of the vocal tract makes speech articulation directly observable, but the trade-off between temporal resolution and signal quality introduces substantial noise and obscures fine articulatory detail. Since clean references cannot be acquired for a moving vocal tract, supervised denoising approaches are not applicable in this setting. We propose a self-supervised denoising framework that combines spatiotemporal super-resolution learning with pseudo-supervision derived from a variance-stabilized non-local means filter. A dual-model fusion strategy balances noise suppression and preservation of high-frequency articulatory structure. Experiments on the USC-75 multi-speaker dataset under natural noise conditions show that the ensemble raises the signal-to-noise ratio by 11.9 dB on unseen subjects while attaining more high-frequency articulatory content in the frames. Among tuned implementations of anisotropic diffusion, block-matching filtering, non-local means and pre-smoothed non-local means, every configuration that achieves comparable noise suppression does so at the cost of high-frequency content or of structural fidelity. Under severe added Gaussian, Rayleigh and Rician noise, peak signal-to-noise ratio improves by 7.6 to 11.8 dB and structural similarity roughly triples. An ablation shows that the variance-stabilized pseudo-supervision is an essential element for denoising, and that the effect is attributable to the hard thresholding contained in the stabilization transform.

232. 【2610.38530】From the Superderivative to a Relative-Gradient Edge Operator

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38530

作者：Alejandro Garnung Menéndez

类目：Image and Video Processing (eess.IV); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Roberts and Scharr, Scharr measure absolute, absolute grey-level differences, First-derivative edge detectors, measure absolute grey-level

备注： 15 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:First-derivative edge detectors such as Sobel, Prewitt, Roberts and Scharr measure absolute grey-level differences. We revisit the log-gradient magnitude, a relative-gradient edge operator, and motivate it by analogy with the superderivative, a multiplicative derivative in which the independent variable is perturbed multiplicatively rather than additively. In one and two dimensions the logarithm of the superderivative is a radial logarithmic derivative; its local, origin-free, isotropic analogue is the magnitude of the logarithmic gradient. The resulting operator measures relative rather than absolute change, giving an edge-strength map that is invariant under global intensity rescaling. We present the theory, show how the operator can be implemented in two steps---a classical gradient kernel plus a pointwise division---and compare it with standard first-derivative filters on synthetic images with ground-truth edges and on the official BSDS500 benchmark. We also study a parametric family that interpolates between the absolute gradient and the log-gradient; empirically, the best members are small intermediate exponents, which edge the classical kernels by a small but statistically detectable margin in the per-image metric and, with the same Gaussian smoothing as the single-$\sigma$ Canny, match it in ODS and lead it in OIS and AP, while the tuned Canny remains ahead in ODS. The single-threshold margin over the kernels does not replicate on the held-out test split, and the fully relative endpoint is never the best member, its ranking depending on the edge-map normalisation. The contribution is the construction and the invariance it buys, not a new state of the art.

233. 【2610.37709】owards Myocardial Infarction Diagnosis: An Investigation into Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms using ECG Data

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37709

作者：Rafid Ahnaf,Husne Mubarak,Fahim Ahsan,G. M. Refatul Islam,Rafeed Rahman,Nabuat Zaman Nahim

类目：Image and Video Processing (eess.IV); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

关键词：myocardial injury due, potentially fatal cardiac, fatal cardiac condition, cardiac condition caused, Myocardial Infarction

备注： 18 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Based on the authors' undergraduate thesis at BRAC University (2023)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Myocardial Infarction (MI) is a severe and potentially fatal cardiac condition caused by myocardial injury due to ischemia, and timely detection can substantially reduce its mortality. Electrocardiography (ECG) is the primary diagnostic modality for MI, but manual interpretation is susceptible to human error. In this work, we propose Visionary V2, a multi-step, adaptive filtration method for ECG signal normalization, and use it to study machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches to MI detection on the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database using all 15 available leads. On statistical features extracted from the filtered signals, such as the R-R interval, a Bagging ensemble of decision trees reaches 96.6% accuracy, compared with 87.7% when the signals are processed with BioSPPy. We further generate an image dataset from the filtered signals, on which a custom ResNet-50 misclassifies only 1 of 7,000 validation images and a custom CNN reaches an F1 score of about 98.7%. Finally, we apply LIME, Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients to verify that the image models attend to the ECG waveform rather than the background. These results indicate that careful signal normalization combined with ML and DL models can support fast and accurate automated MI screening.

GitHub 开源热点

1. 开源趋势洞察

  • AI智能体从“对话交互”迈向“技能封装”与“工作流原生化”。开源社区正在重塑AI的使用范式，大模型不再仅是聊天机器人，而是被封装为可插拔、可复用的“技能模块”。book-to-skill2将技术PDF直接转化为Claude Code技能，prompt-master14以零Token浪费实现精准提示词工程。结合微软推出的microsoft/agent-framework15与浏览器自动化扩展nanobrowser16，AI正深度嵌入开发、逆向工程rea12与内容生产hypit5的完整链路。洞察：2026年的AI竞争焦点已转向“Agent技能生态”与“多智能体协同编排”。提示词工程正在被标准化、可版本控制的Skill资产所取代，AI开发正从“写Prompt”进化为“装配工作流”。

  • 端侧大模型部署“傻瓜化”，消费级硬件成为AI算力新节点。随着推理引擎优化与量化技术的成熟，本地运行前沿模型已彻底跨越技术门槛。Strata13实现Qwen3.8-Flash-Next在普通PC上的一键部署，配合hermes-webui9与claudecodeui18等跨端UI层，打破了CLI工具的使用壁垒。洞察：云端API依赖正在结构性减弱。“Local-First AI”架构凭借数据隐私、零延迟与边际成本优势，正推动开发者工作站向“个人AI超算”演进，开源UI层成为连接底层推理引擎与大众用户的关键桥梁。

  • Rust语言垄断高性能基建，开启“传统重型软件”开源重构潮。本周榜单中Rust项目呈现爆发式渗透，从系统级清理czkawka3、前端构建rolldown19到数据管道dbt-core17，更出现了纯Rust零依赖重构Photoshop的photocraft11。洞察：Rust已跨越早期生态瓶颈，成为内存安全与极致性能的默认选择。开源社区正利用其零成本抽象能力，系统性重写过去被商业闭源垄断的重型生产力工具，软件基建的“Rust化”已进入深水区。

  • 开源价值回归“实用主义”与“证据驱动”的知识平权。登顶榜首的HowToLiveBetter1以破纪录的热度印证了社区对“反焦虑、重证据”结构化知识的渴求。结合免费域名基建DNSHE-FreeDomains6、安卓底层权限KernelSU8与安全研究库MalwareSourceCode10，开源精神正从纯代码协作延伸至生活指南与底层工具的“实用工具带”。洞察：在AI生成内容泛滥的当下，具备明确成本收益分析、原始出处溯源的“高信噪比”开源项目，正成为开发者与大众对抗信息噪声与不确定性的核心数字资产。

HackerNews 技术热点

1. 技术趋势洞察

AI从“通用对话”向“形式化推理与工程自治”纵深演进
AI数学进展开源14 以破纪录的互动量表明，技术社区的关注重心已彻底转向AI在严密逻辑、定理证明与科学发现中的可验证能力。模型不再仅是内容生成器，而是逐步成为科研协作者。与此同时，GPT-6与智能UI9 与 Docker Agent开源11 揭示了AI向交互层与基础设施层的垂直渗透：前端UI正走向意图驱动的自动生成，而DevOps运维则迈向代理自治。配合 Claude Haiku 5.51 的迭代，高吞吐、低延迟的轻量化推理模型将成为支撑上述场景的底层标配。

Web生态迎来“标准效率拐点”与“反臃肿”极简主义回潮
Chrome支持JPEG XL10 标志着长达数年的图像格式之争尘埃落定，Web媒体传输正式进入高压缩比与高动态范围并重的新阶段。与之形成有趣对照的是，URL即应用工具8 倡导的零依赖理念与 网页动态ASCII艺术17 的创意实践，折射出开发者对重型JS框架与复杂构建链的审美疲劳。声明式、免部署、轻量化的Web原生体验正重新获得工程青睐，形成一股对抗技术栈过度设计的清流。

底层系统Craftsmanship与“物理-数字”精度深度耦合
在AI不断抽象高层业务逻辑的当下，工程师正回归对底层性能的极致打磨。Swift极简内核13、控制流重构逻辑12 与 MySQL新存储引擎15 共同展现了对内存管理、I/O吞吐与代码代数的严谨追求。这种对“精确性”的执着已跨越软件边界，钍核钟正式启振7 与 机器精度演进史18 指向一个明确趋势：计算系统正与原子级时间标准及精密制造深度融合，为下一代高可靠、低容错的自治系统奠定物理基石。

技术史观的回溯与科学严谨性的再确认
软件工程先驱辞世3 登顶热度榜，不仅是社区对阿波罗时代奠基者的致敬，更是AI狂飙期对“系统工程纪律”与“失效安全设计”的集体反思。结合 DNA影像历史新解4 对科学贡献的实证修正，HN社区展现出强烈的历史意识与求真精神：在追逐技术跃迁的同时，不遗忘底层方法论的严谨性，这正是抵御技术泡沫、构建可持续创新的核心锚点。

HuggingFace 论文热点

1. 研究趋势洞察

  • 智能体范式跃迁：从“单点执行”走向“自编排元系统”。当前Agent研究正突破单模型能力瓶颈，转向解决长程跨域工作流的编排复杂度。Raven11 提出“可组合智能体Harness”概念，让系统自主构建并迭代专用工作流；配合CLMs13 将上下文原生视为可读写文件，以及Mem09 的图结构长期记忆，Agent正获得“元认知”与持续演化的基础设施。ARIS20 进一步验证了多智能体对抗协作在自动化科研中的可靠性，标志着Agent向“自主决策与自我进化实体”演进。

  • 世界模型与视觉骨干强化“物理先验”与“测试时自适应”：视频生成模型正从纯数据驱动转向注入人类核心认知先验，如通过专用数据集训练物体恒常性(世界模型物体恒常性15)。同时，实证研究明确指出：为追求推理速度而丢弃显式未来建模的Latent WAM会严重损害泛化能力，显式未来预测仍是物理智能泛化的关键(世界动作模型泛化性7)。在视觉表征侧，骨干网络突破静态权重限制，实现测试时自修改与输入自适应计算(VisionHOPE自修改视觉骨干11)，为具身控制与高保真物理仿真奠定动态计算基石。

  • 多模态生成与解析呈现“解耦协同”与“符号-音频统一”：复杂文档解析正摆脱单体大模型算力瓶颈，转向解耦架构与粗到细策略(MinerU2.5高效文档解析20)，并在极致轻量化方向取得突破(SmolDocling轻量文档解析14)。在创意生成领域，音乐模型首次打通“符号作曲规划→语义Token扩展→全曲音频渲染”链路(YuE2符号音频音乐生成17)。多模态系统整体从“黑盒端到端融合”转向“结构化规划+可控生成”的新范式，兼顾可解释性、编辑性与生成质量。

① 智能体进化范式从“参数微调”转向“Harness（系统外壳）递归自优”
当前Agent研究正经历底层逻辑重构：能力跃升不再依赖基座模型权重的反复更新，而是聚焦于Prompt、控制流、工具链与记忆组成的“Harness”系统级迭代。RRSI4 与 NeoHorse-112 揭示了递归自我改进（RSI）的巨大潜力，但明确指出无约束演化极易导致训练任务过拟合。为此，SkillOpt8 将技能抽象为可稳定更新的“外部文本状态”，实现零推理开销的持续进化；Harness VLA16 则通过记忆引导路由弥补冻结VLA模型的分布外泛化缺陷。核心洞察：未来的Agent竞争将是“架构工程”与“进化算法”的竞争。正则化RSI、课程蒸馏与外部技能优化将取代传统SFT，成为构建自适应、抗过拟合智能体的标准范式。

② 世界模型跨越“像素拟合”，迈向“物理认知与几何先验”原生时代
视频生成模型正从视觉保真度竞赛，快速转向对物理规律与空间一致性的内化。WROP13 首次系统性地为视频模型注入“客体永久性”这一人类核心认知先验；WorldCrafter11 与 GAE15 则分别从隐式3D感知记忆与几何原生潜在空间入手，破解了多视角生成中的结构坍塌难题。配合 GameHorizon17 等多时距交互评测基准，核心洞察：世界模型的评价标准已从“像不像”转变为“懂不懂物理”。具备3D一致性、客体守恒与长程因果推理的“交互式物理模拟器”，将成为具身智能与下一代内容生成的统一底座。

③ 推理效率与端侧部署成为“一等公民”，内存-带宽-算力三角迎来系统级重构
随着模型上下文与参数规模触及硬件瓶颈，服务效率研究从“工程优化”升级为“核心学术前沿”。FreeToken18 针对边缘设备异构特性，提出带宽自适应的MoE路由执行策略；Unlimited OCR14 以参考滑动窗口注意力彻底消除长序列内存线性膨胀；而 SPEED-Bench1 的推出标志着投机解码进入标准化评估阶段。结合经典工作 PagedAttention6，核心洞察：大模型落地正从“云端暴力堆料”转向“端云协同的精打细算”。内存管理、动态路由与长序列注意力优化将深度耦合，推动百亿级多模态模型在个人设备上的原生普及。

  • 智能体架构向“状态持久化与可验证执行”演进：当前Agent研究正突破单轮工具调用瓶颈，转向长程复杂任务的稳健交付。Apodex 1.19与Prime Agent14通过递归子智能体协同、持久计算与故障恢复机制，显著提升了长视野任务的连续性。结合AutoResearch4“生成-证据执行”双阶段设计，表明Agent正从“概率性输出”迈向“抗幻觉、可审计”的自主数字员工范式，工程与科研自动化（如AutoDev3、AgentScope 1.015）已进入可用临界点。

  • 多模态大模型重塑具身控制与空间感知边界：视觉语言模型正从“被动理解者”转变为“通用动作控制器”。Show-Harness12利用离散语义动作直接桥接VLM与机器人底层控制，实现跨平台零样本部署；OpenWAM20则通过模块化预训练提炼世界-动作模型的设计原则。同时，Marigold V213将Diffusion Transformer重构为单步流匹配深度估计器，印证了生成架构向密集预测与物理交互任务迁移的强劲趋势，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）的模态壁垒正在消融。

  • 端侧自适应服务与稀疏化打破算力垄断：大模型部署重心从“云端堆参”转向“端存算协同优化”。FreeToken8提出带宽自适应的MoE调度策略，动态映射异构本地硬件，使个人设备运行开源大模型成为现实。配合SAS18在Softmax内引入连续门控的端到端稀疏注意力机制，以及经典PagedAttention17的KV缓存管理思想，行业正通过算法-系统联合设计实现高吞吐与低延迟的普惠推理，边缘原生AI将成为下一代基础设施标配。

  • 音频基座模型攻克长程连贯与实时记忆瓶颈：语音与音乐生成正摆脱短片段拼接局限，向具备上下文感知与情感连续性的交互模型演进。AuK6统一了指令驱动的语音生成与编辑，YuE2实现了结构对齐的长音乐创作，而VoiceMem11创新的双脑流式记忆架构大幅提升了实时交互中的检索精度与情感个性化。音频模态正加速融入多模态Agent的实时交互闭环，推动人机对话向“类人陪伴”体验跃升。

本期开源生态呈现出**“AI智能体垂直化落地”与“本地优先/隐私计算回归”**的双主线演进特征，技术栈正从“模型能力竞赛”转向“工程化与主权化”深水区：

  • AI Agent 从“通用对话”迈向“工业级工作流”：大模型应用正加速渗透至专业垂直领域，并通过标准化协议打通传统工具链。例如 Unity MCP15 借助 MCP 协议将 AI 助手深度接入 Unity 编辑器，实现资产管理与场景自动化；Waoowaoo14 与 LiveKit Agents11 分别瞄准影视工业级生产与实时语音交互，表明 AI 正在重构高复杂度、多模态的专业工作流。同时，Archify8 和 Fireworks Tech Graph20 等技术绘图工具的集中涌现，印证了“AI 生成可验证架构/流程图”已成为研发提效的新标配，智能体正从“内容生成者”进化为“系统设计协作者”。

  • MCP 与 Agent 技能库生态初具雏形：智能体的能力边界不再依赖单一模型微调，而是转向“技能插件化”与“角色人格化”。Skills18 直接以 .agents 目录形式共享工程师实战技能，而 Ponytail19 则通过注入“资深开发者极简思维”优化 AI 编码策略。这标志着开源社区正在从“提示词工程（Prompt Engineering）”全面转向“智能体技能工程（Agent Skill Engineering）”，可复用、可组合、带角色偏好的 Agent 能力模块将成为下一代开发生态的核心资产。

  • 本地优先（Local-First）与隐私自治成为底层共识：在云端 AI 狂飙的同时，开发者对数据主权、低延迟与无遥测的诉求显著回升。Web-LLM4 实现浏览器端高性能 LLM 推理，配合 OpenLogi3（无账号/无遥测的本地外设驱动）与 ActivityWatch7（隐私优先的时间追踪），勾勒出“端侧智能+本地自治”的技术范式。Rust 语言在 OpenLogi3 与 GPUI Component10 中的高频应用，进一步印证了高性能、内存安全的系统级语言正成为构建本地优先应用的基石。

  • 自助托管（Self-Hosted）与开发者基础设施平民化：ConvertX5、Cloud-Mail13 与 DNSHE-FreeDomains9 的爆发，反映出开发者对“去中心化、低成本、API 驱动”的基础设施需求旺盛。开源正从“提供代码”转向“提供可一键部署的完整服务栈”，大幅降低个人开发者与中小团队的运维与合规门槛。

1. 研究趋势洞察

① 智能体从“单轮任务执行”向“持久化复杂工作流”跃迁
当前Agentic AI的研究重心已跨越基础工具调用，全面聚焦于长程规划、状态维护与自我演进。通过引入递归子代理协同与持久化计算机制Prime Agent4，以及可执行环境中的断点恢复能力Apodex 1.16，模型开始具备处理跨天/跨步骤复杂业务的韧性。与此同时，图结构长期记忆系统Mem017与开发者导向的多智能体框架AgentScope 1.011的成熟，标志着智能体开发正从“提示词编排”转向“状态机与容错架构设计”，为金融TradingAgents3与软件工程OpenDevin9等垂直领域的工业级落地铺平道路。

② “端侧自适应”与“算法级内存优化”重塑部署范式
算力焦虑正被硬件感知调度与极致显存管理所化解，轻量化与边缘原生成为新增长极。研究不再盲目堆叠参数，而是通过带宽自适应的MoE动态映射FreeToken1与循环潜在推理BDH-CQ2，使1.5亿参数模型即可逼近复杂推理前沿。在系统层，经典KV缓存分页技术PagedAttention13的思想正向下渗透至垂直任务，如长文档OCR的滑动窗口注意力Unlimited OCR15与解耦式文档解析VLMMinerU2.516。AI部署正从“中心化大集群”向“异构边缘原生”迁移，实现高吞吐、低延迟与低成本的三角平衡。

③ 多模态表征向“流式实时”与“物理可计算”升维
多模态技术正突破静态图文对齐局限，迈向动态流式交互与物理世界可执行表征。统一嵌入空间已能无缝融合交错模态WeMM-Embedding5，而语音交互则通过双脑流式记忆架构实现情感与上下文的毫秒级同步VoiceMem10。更具范式意义的是，视觉语言模型开始将物理环境抽象为可执行代码Code as Worlds8，结合仅依赖局部时序的流式3D重建ABot-Recon7与单目4D高斯人体生成4DAnyone18，AI正从“感知多媒体”转向“理解并模拟物理规律”，为具身智能与空间计算奠定可微、可推理的底层表征基础。
